jointConstraints.rule: If what designates a mouse-related event (Mouse down/Mouse up), message must be 0 (zero); if what designates a keyboard-related event (Key down/Key up/Auto key), message must hold the code of the simulated character.
mouseX/mouseY only carry meaningful click coordinates when what is a mouse-related event.

constraints: when is normally the value returned by Tickcount.
modifiers takes one or a combination of the Events (Modifiers) theme constants.
If process is 0 or omitted, the event is posted at the application level and dispatched by the 4D scheduler to the appropriate process.
